rationale: The workflow runs Python jobs that reinstall dependencies (poetry install) on every PR/run with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) supports caching dependency downloads using a lockfile-keyed cache to cut repeated fetch time while preserving all tests. The repository has poetry.lock and pyproject.toml, and both Python jobs use poetry, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs include a lockfile. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on runner.os plus poetry.lock in the Ubuntu verify-recovery job (where ~/.cache/pip is pip's actual cache directory) reuses downloaded wheels across runs without changing test coverage, permissions, or adding network/privileged access. The Windows job is left unchanged because pip's Windows cache directory differs from ~/.cache/pip, so caching that path there would be ineffective.
